The area product of inertia measures the asymmetry of a cross-section’s area distribution with respect to a pair of perpendicular axes

The area product of inertia for a cross-section $A$ according to orthonormal base $B$ is:

$$
I_{xy} = \int_A {x}{y}\ dA
$$
<ref>{{#cite:Q2278}}</ref>

== Parallel axes theorem ==

$$
I_{xy} = I_{x'y'} + A \bar{x}\bar{y}
$$
